subject: BOX-003 lint is a DENYLIST and cannot catch a call to a method BoxEngine does not have
description:
_tools/eduscan/box-engine-api-lint.js checks box configs against KNOWN_INVALID, a hand-written list of method names already known to be wrong. It therefore catches nothing new by construction. engine.resetLab() was never on the list, so all 46 boxes calling it passed the lint while the Reset Lab desktop icon was dead in every one of them (student confirms, TypeError, nothing happens). This is the SECOND time an engine.<nonexistent method> call has shipped silently; the lint's own header cites engine.subtractPoints as the reason it exists. FIX: derive the valid method set from BoxEngine.js (and the other engines) and flag any engine.<name>() call whose name is not in it -- the same shape as SHELL-004, which derives its required command list from Terminal.js rather than a hand-written enumeration, and which is what caught the 'id' leak the hand-written 'nine commands' had hidden. Raised by Nancy (adversarial-reviewer) during the resetLab review, 2026-09-12.
[2026-09-13 21:34] SHIPPED + VERIFIED LIVE 2026-09-13 (53e278806). BOX-003 now derives 132 valid members from the engine (vm-eval BoxEngine.js + this.X= + BoxEngine.X= from sibling engine files) instead of a 12-name denylist. Canary: derived set must contain 9 known members and be >=50 or the gate exits 2 and refuses a verdict -- a wrong allowlist goes BLIND rather than failing, which is how resetLab survived. Proven against the pre-fix engine: resetLab absent, rule fires. Baseline force-added (Nancy caught it untracked, which would have failed deploys on every other clone). Chris confirmed the smoke runner treats exit-2 as always-blocking. Live and gated its own deploy: SMOKE GATE PASS.
